The DermaSensor device is FDA-cleared and available for sale in Florida and Pennsylvania. The device is available for joining our waitlist in all other U.S. states.
 








For Press Inquiries:
 








press@dermasensor.com
 


























































 










*DermaSensor is indicated to assist in referral
decisions for suspicious lesions; studies have
shown that the device increases physicians' rate of
correct referrals (i.e. referral sensitivity) of skin
cancer, thus resulting in more timely referral to
dermatology.
